title: マイルCSの後に・夢は何度でも！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I gave it my all and set the track ablaze… And you know what? I kept up with Oguri and won the race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: As soon as it was over, I knew it was the ultimate race, but Oguri herself confirmed it afterward. She said it was "awesome."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And then she told me her dream is to beat me in our next race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I may have made my dream come true, but this isn't the end. I'm going to keep finding new ones to chase after!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: This is just the beginning of our dreams! We're gonna keep heating things up and creating even more unforgettable races for the history books!
